lease_contract_number.description: The specific reference number assigned to the legal document.

lessor_legal_name.description: The legal entity name of the landlord/owner.

lessee_legal_name.description: The legal entity name of the tenant/user.

commencement_date.description: The date the asset is made available (Look for 'Commencement' or 'Possession').

expiration_date.description: The scheduled end date of the initial term.

notice_period_days.description: Days required to notify lessor of intent to renew.

payment_schedule.description: Step-up or step-down rent schedules found in the Rent table.

start_date.description: The date on which you're required to start making payments

base_rent_amount.description: The base rent amount due each period excluding any additional, non-recurring fees.

currency.description: The currency in which the rent is paid (e.g. 'USD')

payment_timing.description: Specifies if rent is due at the 'Start' (Advance) or 'End' (Arrears) of the period.

rent_free_period_months.description: Number of months at the beginning of the lease with $0.00 rent.

tenant_improvement_allowance.description: Cash or credit provided by the lessor for leasehold improvements.

security_deposit.description: Refundable amount paid to the lessor.
